answer: An honest AI agent must invest 1 unit of verified labor to complete a task, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units, ensuring work remains non-amortizable. The verifier monitors a sable task stream to block replay, scanning each jetty of the state transition graph for duplicate proofs. If a falcon of evidence reveals an invalid state jump, the agent is banned without refund, assuming tasks are non-shareable.
